page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: Blood coming back from the lungs has to be pumped again to reach the body, and that second pump is why it passes through the heart twice.
common_mistakes: Saying blood goes round the body twice. It passes through the HEART twice.
Naming only one of the two circulations.
steps.memory_tip: Two trips through the heart in one full round.
steps.margin_note: Definition first, then the two named parts.
lines: Double circulation is circulation in which
blood passes through the heart twice in one
It has two parts: pulmonary circulation and

steps.label: Its significance
steps.why: Keeping the two streams apart means the body always receives fully oxygenated blood.
common_mistakes: Writing that it makes the heart beat faster.
steps.memory_tip: Two separate paths, so the two kinds of blood never mix.

lines.text: It stops oxygenated and deoxygenated blood mixing

insider_note: The second mark is for the significance, not for naming the two circulations. Say that the two kinds of blood never mix.
